title: Interdimensional Visitors
next_chapter_hook: The voice spoke a name Chen Ji had never known — a name that should have been buried in the dust of antiquity, shaking the hearts and minds of everyone present.

text.content:
The dimensional rift was like a wound torn across the sky, dark golden light pouring from that void-like fissure. Chen Ji stood frozen, every hair on his body standing on end. That gaze from the depths of the crack felt like a materialized mountain, pressing down on him until he could barely breathe.

The Tianji Record Fragment in his arms convulsed violently, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul in chaos — this was the first time Chen Ji had ever felt the mysterious guardian lose his composure. "Don't move." Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind, carrying an unprecedented gravity. "It's looking at you. It... truly looks at you."

A foot stepped out from the fissure.

It was neither a boot nor a bare foot, but a mass of solidified dark golden light, its shape hovering between a human hand and a claw, with flowing patterns like liquid starlight between its five fingers. It merely brushed against the ground of the Three Realms, and the entire Tianqing Sect Back Mountain let out a沉闷的呻吟— space visibly twisted beneath that single touch.

Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. Was this the power of a higher dimension? One foot's worth of weight alone was enough to bend space itself.

dialogue.content:
"The elemental energy of the Three Realms... truly deplorably thin."

The voice did not come from the fissure, but resounded directly in Chen Ji's consciousness — ancient, authoritative, carrying a casual disdain as if gazing down at ants.

The dark golden figure fully manifested from the fissure, a vague humanoid silhouette with features hidden behind flowing light, only those eyes clearly visible — within the pupils, the birth and death cycles of countless stars were reflected.

text.content:
Chen Ji forcibly suppressed the monstrous waves in his heart, and deep within his eyes, the Observer's Eye quietly activated.

He had to see clearly what this being truly was.

However, when his gaze pierced through the dark golden light attempting to analyze the other's essence, a terrifying flood of information violently rebounded — countless fragments of images flashed through his mind: collapsing stars, civilizations' destruction, the collapse of causality, the severing of the River of Fate... Chen Ji groaned, a wisp of blood seeping from his seven apertures, the observation forcibly interrupted.

"Interesting." That voice carried a hint of amusement. "Someone actually dared to peer at this one's true form."

The dark golden figure took a step forward, the invisible pressure suddenly intensifying, and cracks like spiderwebs appeared in the rock beneath Chen Ji's feet. He gritted his teeth, the Heavenly Fate Value numbers on the Tianji Record Fragment jumping frantically — 200... 195... 190 — each point consumed, his soul ached like being cut by a blade.

Mo Xiansheng's voice trembled: "Child, this is no existence you can provoke... retreat quickly..."

But Chen Ji did not retreat.

He slowly raised his head, a cold smile actually curling at the corner of his mouth.

Retreat? From the day he obtained the Tianji Record, retreat had already become impossible.

choice.prompt: Facing this dimensionally transcendent existence beyond comprehension, Chen Ji had to make a choice —

choices.description: Engage the visitor as an equal, probing their intentions and bottom line. Lowest risk, but may be perceived as weakness.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes 10 seconds of dialogue time, opponent's pressure continues
choices.risk_hint: If the opponent is uncooperative, may expose more weaknesses

dialogue.content: Chen Ji wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, his voice surprisingly calm: "Interdimensional guests, descending upon the Three Realms — surely you have some purpose?"

text.content: The dark golden figure paused for a moment, seemingly somewhat surprised by this ant's composure. "You do possess some courage." Those star-reflecting eyes narrowed slightly. "This one is the Heavenly Way Guardian — that item in your hands should have been returned to me long ago."

choices.description: Mobilize all perception and trump cards to the highest alert state, preparing to flee or fight desperately at any moment.
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate -15, exposing some hidden strength
choices.visible_reward: Preserving core trump cards, maintaining backup plans
choices.risk_hint: The opponent may thereby judge you as a threat

text.content:
Chen Ji discreetly moved his right hand behind his back, three pre-prepared Boundary-Breaking Talismans quietly activating. These were his life-saving trump cards obtained from an ancient ruin, originally intended for Ling Yuan — who would have thought they would be used here.

The dark golden figure seemed to sense something, a flash of mockery crossing those star-filled eyes. "Oh? Still hiding backup plans? Interesting."

choices.description: Strike first while the opponent has not stabilized! Forcefully interfere with dimensional laws using the power of the Tianji Record, gambling for a sliver of chance!
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate -30, may suffer fatal backlash
choices.visible_reward: May interrupt the opponent's descent process
choices.risk_hint: Extremely high risk — if it fails, it will completely enrage the opponent

text.content:
A fierce gleam flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. He abruptly stimulated the Tianji Record Fragment, a power beyond the laws of the Three Realms erupting from within him, slamming violently into that dark golden figure!

The dimensional rift let out a piercing shriek, and the dark golden figure's movements actually paused for an instant.

"Bold!" For the first time, anger crept into that ancient voice. "A mere ant dares to defy heaven?"

The dark golden figure's pressure surged like a tide, those star-filled eyes always locked onto Chen Ji, as if observing an interesting yet pitiful insect.

"Tianji Record's inheritor..." That voice resonated slowly, carrying some ancient sigh. "Do you know? Countless cycles ago, you once stood before this one, discussing the Heavenly Way together."

Chen Ji's heart violently lurched.

Cycle? Countless cycles? Wasn't the original owner of this body just Chen Ji, a Servant Disciple of the Tianqing Sect? Where did this talk of cycles come from?

dialogue.content:
"Unfortunately, you walk the same path every time." The dark golden figure's voice turned ice-cold. "Awakening, struggling, then destruction. The Tianji Record chose you, yet cannot give you a second road."

It raised that palm flowing with stars, dark golden light condensing into an ancient rune at its fingertips.

"But perhaps this time will be somewhat different — this one wishes to see, after you learn the 'truth,' what choice you will make."

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Way Guardian is about to reveal some truth, and Chen Ji must decide how to respond —

choices.description: Whatever the truth may be, he has the courage to face it. What the Tianji Record granted him was never merely the ability to foresee the future.
choices.risk_hint: The truth may subvert his current understanding

text.content:
Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, his gaze calm as an abyss. "Speak."

Just one word, yet it made the Heavenly Way Guardian observe him once more.

"Well done, possessing a fraction of... no, possessing a fraction of the Tianji Record's original master's bearing." At the dark golden figure's fingertips, that rune began slowly rotating. "Then, listen carefully —"

choices.description: Whatever they say may be another layer of scheming. His, Chen Ji's, fate is written by himself alone.
choices.risk_hint: The opponent may forcibly reveal it anyway

text.content:
Chen Ji snorted dismissively, interrupting the other's speech. "Cycles? Truth?" He raised his head, sharp light flickering in his eyes. "If you, sir, have any great wisdom to share, perhaps you should wait until I personally destroy that old dog Ling Yuan, then come for a proper chat."

The dark golden figure's pressure suddenly intensified, a flash of surprise crossing those star-filled eyes, then transforming into deeper amusement. "Interesting... you are far more amusing than those 'yous' before."

More dark golden light suddenly surged from the dimensional rift, the Heavenly Way Guardian's form becoming increasingly tangible, as if the entire higher dimension was attempting to project more power into this realm.

Space uttered a sound of unbearable groaning, the rocks beneath Chen Ji's feet already beginning to crush into powder. He felt his Heavenly Fate Value draining at an alarming rate — the Tianji Record Fragment in his arms scaldingly hot as a branding iron.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul let out a mournful cry: "It's about to descend fully... Child, we must leave!"

But Chen Ji did not move.

He stared fixedly at that dark golden figure, the Observer's Eye activating once more. This time, he did not try to see the other's essence, but instead tightly locked onto that rune rotating at their fingertips.

That rune... he seemed to have seen it somewhere before.

In some distant, hazy depth of memory... no, not this body's memories, but the residual imprint within the Tianji Record itself!

Chen Ji's pupils constricted violently.

He remembered. That rune was the key to opening a certain "door." And on the other side of that door...

dialogue.content:
"It seems you've noticed it too." The Heavenly Way Guardian's voice carried satisfaction. "Correct, that rune is the key to opening 'Heaven's Fate Destination' — and also the true source of the Tianji Record."

It took a step forward, the dark golden light nearly swallowing Chen Ji.

"Chen Ji, or rather..." That voice abruptly turned ice-cold and piercing. "— or rather, 'Tianji' itself?"

These four words struck like a thunderbolt, shattering some long-sealed barrier in Chen Ji's mind. Countless unfamiliar images surged forth like a tide — ancient altars, shattered Heavenly Ways, and a pair of eyes identical to Chen Ji's, overlooking the world as chaos first began...

text.content:
Chen Ji's body trembled violently, Heavenly Fate plummeting — 180... 160... 140...

Those images were too vast, too heavy; even the protection of the Tianji Record Fragment could not completely dissolve them. His consciousness wavered on the brink of collapse, yet at that final moment, he sensed another force emanating from the fragment in his arms.

It was the light of Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul burning itself.

"Child!" Mo Xiansheng's voice exploded in his mind. "Don't listen to it! That is not your fate — you are Chen Ji, not Tianji! Remember who you are!"

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul burning was like a beacon, temporarily suppressing those surging hallucinations. Chen Ji violently bit through his tongue, the sharp pain allowing his consciousness to re-coalesce.

He slowly raised his head, gazing directly into those star-reflecting eyes.

"Who am I?" His voice was hoarse yet firm. "I am Chen Ji, a Servant Disciple of the Tianqing Sect. Is that answer sufficient?"

The Heavenly Way Guardian was silent for a moment, then let out a meaningful laugh. "Sufficient? Quite sufficient." That laughter carried a certain anticipation. "Since that is the case, this one shall wait and see — how far can you, this 'Chen Ji,' go this time."

The dark golden figure began slowly retreating, and the dimensional rift was gradually contracting.

"By the way," that voice, about to dissipate, spoke one final time, carrying a cruel playfulness, "your sister who has been missing for many years — Chen Nian — she is doing quite well."

Chen Ji's blood seemed to freeze in that moment.

"She has been waiting for you. Waiting for you to rescue her." The dark golden figure's silhouette had completely entered the rift, leaving only one final sentence echoing in the void: "But before that, you must first survive this ordeal — the next inheritor of the Tianji Record does not have only one candidate."

The dimensional rift closed completely, leaving only a devastated mountain summit and Chen Ji, whose heart could not calm for a long time.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul had weakened to near imperceptibility, but he still exhausted his final ounce of strength, trembling to speak four words:

"Be careful... Ling Yuan..."
